camera.title: Caregiver Mode – Fall Detection (optional)
camera.description:
Optional: use a camera and AI to detect falls. Leave camera blank to skip.

Groq (free) requires a Groq API key. If you already entered a Groq key for AI notifications, enter the same key here.

Ollama URL and model are only used when Ollama is selected as provider.

Detect falls using a camera and AI vision. Select no camera to disable.

Groq (free) requires a Groq API key. If you use Groq for AI notifications, enter the same key.

Ollama URL and model are only used when Ollama is selected.

pattern.title: Caregiver Mode – Pattern Learning
pattern.description:
Pattern learning observes the person's daily rhythm and computes an anomaly score (0–100). After 7 days of data the sensor becomes active.

Enable 'Early warning alerts' to get notified when the score exceeds the threshold — before the normal inactivity alert fires.
